scope: Source inventory, deterministic local-fixture verification, dashboard/API boundary checks, idempotency behavior, and truthful-claim review for the NecroOps source revision.
executionBoundary: All verified workflows use local in-memory fixtures. The audit did not connect to AWS, query CloudWatch or Cost Explorer, deploy a Lambda, execute Kiro Crew/CLI/Web, run a Kiro hook or power, or terminate an AWS resource.
sourceRevisionIdentity: This SHA-256 inventory, not a Git commit ID, identifies the audited source exactly. A later commit or web upload must reproduce every listed file hash to be covered by this record.
verificationCommands: POST /api/kiro-crew/execute with an explicit local fixture resourceId

automatedTestResult.note: Node TAP counts the outer suite in addition to its 18 named nested checks. The standalone gate is run after the TAP suite by npm run ci.

manualLocalSmokeResult.statusEndpoint: GET /api/status returned local-demo-fixtures-no-aws-account, five active fixtures, risk index 88, and an explicit target.
manualLocalSmokeResult.workflowEndpoint: A first POST /api/kiro-crew/execute for the explicit EC2 fixture returned EXORCISED, mutated true, a 100/100 local gate, a 64-character receipt digest, four remaining active fixtures, and risk index 65.
manualLocalSmokeResult.idempotentWorkflowRetry: A repeated POST for that already-exorcised fixture returned ALREADY_EXORCISED, mutated false, modeledMonthlyChangeUSD 0, localFixtureReceipt null, and a LOCAL_NO_OP_ALREADY_EXORCISED action. It did not claim a new state transition or rerun the safety gate.
manualLocalSmokeResult.validationEndpoint: Object-only JSON, content type, body size, reason, resource ID, method, static-path, engine-error, and local idempotency paths were exercised by automated HTTP tests.
manualLocalSmokeResult.dashboard: GET / served the explicit LOCAL DEMO FIXTURES — NO AWS ACCOUNT CONNECTED boundary.

claimReview.dashboard: The dashboard fetches same-origin API state and returned receipts; it does not use timer-only simulated success. It handles an idempotent no-op result without attempting to render a new receipt.
claimReview.financialInvariant: The legacy fee expression and the independent modern BigInt rational oracle agree across deterministic property trials. Generated modern fixture code is executed in test against the oracle. The accepted domain is safe integer cents from $0.32 through $15,000.00.
claimReview.kiroAssets: Root .kiro assets exist and label themselves illustrative/unverified. Their presence is not runtime execution evidence.
claimReview.receipt: Receipt digest is a SHA-256 integrity check over canonical local-fixture receipt data; it is unsigned and is not proof of a cloud action.
claimReview.license: README, package.json, and LICENSE identify MIT.

publicationNote: This audit does not establish Devpost completion, public demo-video publication, public functional hosting, entrant eligibility, original-project timing, bonus eligibility, or actual Kiro runtime use. It records only the listed local-source evidence.
